findings.text: a zone-naming stamp that is not "T"-separated comes back with its zone stripped: at base "2026-09-29 01:02:03+00:00" returned aware 2026-09-29T01:02:03+00:00 and at head it returns naive 2026-09-29T01:02:03, losing the instant rather than preserving it; the condition is not produced by the records this caller reads (0 of 4,179 sampled ~/.codex/sessions records use a space separator) but the code contradicts the rule stated at rollout.py:237-239.

the new _states_zone gate narrows what the reader accepts: the same space-separated zone-naming stamp returned ("2026-09-29T01:02:03+00:00", "utc") at base and (None, "unknown") at head, so a stored stamp that states its zone is now reported as naming none.

the two suite observations are written as block YAML rather than the armed JSON the manifest template names, so reckon/crew/review.py takes the first indented key as the gate path, both logs read absent, and the read path stores added_failure_count as unmeasured for this run instead of the 0 the two logs support.

states "A private helper left with no caller is deleted" while no def line is deleted anywhere in the diff - the only removals outside function bodies are three datetime imports - so a reader cannot identify which helper was meant or whether one was removed at all.

labels the base arm 142cdf05 where base_arm.txt:1 and manifest.md:48 both record it at a15e11cb; 142cdf05 is the revision the recorded outputs were taken at, so the row names the wrong evidence for its own 4 failed / 346 passed figures.
